title: Social Signal
tagline: Social Signal - Form your tribe and signal your values across all web3 apps.
description:
One of the most important things for human beings, is feeling part of something, of a group. You are more than an address.

Signal what's important about YOU to others !

See an instant auto-generated story of any account with instant icebreakers accessible all across web3 to identify overlapping Values, POAPs, NFTs, and mainly Tribes.

NFTs don't fully capture this spectrum of values. Tribes do.

Tribes apply constraints to traditional NFTs in that they require a relationship link in both directions: both from the owner of the Tribe and from all members of the Tribe.

View the list of all tribes that share your values. Pick a primary tribe to signal what's important to you in a mini-badge right next to your name across web3.

Telegram does it, Twitter does it. We need this in our community in an accessible way, without needing to pay for having it in just one platform.

Social Signal combines:

1. A new open and decentralized protocol that anyone can adopt.
2. A documented open API
3. A Tribe and Value manager web application.
4. A UI kit that any web3 app can add to their frontend to provide rich Tribe functionality.
5. A browser extension that enables rich Tribe functionality on any web3 app.
how_its_made:
We created a combination of products to make this happen.

- A set of smart contracts that can be deployed on any chain, reaching every ecosystem. These are Factory contracts that can deploy Tribe contracts. Triba contracts are NFT's that are minted only if the tribe manager and the user both accept to have the relationship (that's ready 100%)
- A broswer extension to give this data about addresses while you're navigating on Dapps (E.g.: Etherscan) (80% complete, justo with some basic features)
- A Dapp that let you create this organization, set an ENS for it and deploy this structure in your chain of choice (40% just basic feature like setting ENS, creating tribe. Not possible to exit a tribe and etc)
- A backend based on TheGraph that it's an amazing tool to index all these different communities growing on different chains. (Just one chain integrated, if we had more time we would integrate with all networks we deployed the contracts)

Other social features can be unlocked from this primitive, and we envision it being about suggesting better connections and relations, on-chain.
